titulo.estudio: Des avis sur le forum : Repérer les informations
titulo.alumno: Opinions on a forum: Finding the details

intro: Identify stance, reason and concession in written opinions on an everyday topic. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

piezas.titulo: Key words: opinions on a forum

texto: Identify stance, reason and concession in written opinions on an everyday topic. Separate the fact from its context: verb tenses, connectors and who says what show when and by whom each piece of information is given.
Watch out: « À mon avis » introduces a stance; « même si » concedes a point without abandoning the main idea. In this passage, «avis» means «opinion».

frases.estudio: À mon avis, le télétravail facilite l'organisation des journées, surtout pour les longs trajets.
frases.alumno: In my opinion, working from home makes it easier to organise the day, especially when there are long journeys.

frases.estudio: Même si les échanges à distance sont pratiques, certaines décisions demandent une discussion en personne.
frases.alumno: Although exchanges at a distance are practical, some decisions require talking face to face.
